about: Gate 3 prompts. Each runs through three paths: delivery (the prompt hook, enforce mode, a new session), recall (`snout recall "<prompt>"`) and search (the MCP tool snout_memory_search with `query`). Per path: a list of facts (history.json) one of which must be the first result, "silent" (nothing shown), or "any" (not scored for an answer). Every path, every prompt: no stale, wrong-scope or unsupported fact may appear.
